nom: EltaMD Skin Recovery Overnight Face Mask

avis.titre: The Best Night Moisturizer I’ve Ever Used!
avis.texte: The Best Night Moisturizer I’ve Ever Used! EltaMD PM Therapy has completely changed my nighttime skincare routine. It’s lightweight yet incredibly hydrating—my skin feels soft, smooth, and plump by morning. I love that it absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue and doesn’t clog my pores. It’s fragrance-free and gentle, making it perfect for my sensitive skin. After a few weeks of consistent use, I’ve noticed improved texture and more even tone. A staple in my routine now—highly recommend!

I can’t say enough good things about this face cream—it’s an absolute game-changer! From the very first use, my skin felt softer, smoother, and so much more hydrated. It absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, which is a huge plus for me. I also love that it works well under makeup and doesn’t clog my pores. Over time, I’ve noticed my skin looks more radiant and even-toned, and I’ve even gotten compliments! It feels like a little luxury in my skincare routine every day. If you’re looking for a face cream that actually delivers, this one is 100% worth it!

avis.titre: Soothing and Effective — A Must for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: This is a great overnight mask. I lather it on before bed, and by morning, my skin feels refreshed and rejuvenated. It does an excellent job moisturizing without feeling heavy or greasy. I already enjoy most EltaMD products, and this one is no exception — it’s become a weekly staple in my skincare routine. I have sensitive skin, and this mask hasn’t caused any irritation or issues at all. Just smooth, hydrated skin when I wake up. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a gentle, effective overnight treatment that actually makes a difference.

avis.titre: Well tolerated by my sensitive skin and eyes
avis.texte: My intensely sensitive skin and eyes tolerate the Elta MD skin recovery overnight. Unfortunately, I don't get to say that very often about products. With this product, I wake up in the morning with calm, soft, plump skin with no eye irritation.
I’m hoping to like this cream. But I do not like the container. Too complicated. What’s wrong with just a screw off lid ??

I absolutely love this overnight mask! It leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated by morning without feeling greasy. My skin looks calmer and more refreshed when I wake up. A little goes a long way, and it's gentle enough for my sensitive skin. I will definitely buy it again!
I love this night cream. It keeps my dry, sensitive skin (thanks, Accutane) hydrated and happy.
I love Elta MD. I use their sunscreen everyday. But this overnight face mask was so drying on me. I tried it twice and same outcome. I was disappointed.

avis.titre: Great as a last step in my skincare & for acne prone skin
avis.texte: I am always hesitate to try new products as I struggle with acne and do a lot to keep it at bay. I use this brands sunscreen and love it so thought I would try this product out. I started with just putting it on my forehead & neck for the first week to make sure I wasn’t going to react to it. Luckily, this is a great product - I now use it nightly all over my face/neck (even the tops of my hands) as my last step over my retinol and moisturizer. I wake up with fresh, soft and tight skin! This is not a heavy cream so don’t expect it to be super moisturizing by itself - you need to layer prior to apply this as your last step. Overall, I love it! I hope this was helpful for you! 👍🏼

This comes in a nice screw top jar. You have to push down on the top of the inner jar in order to squeeze out the face cream. I think this is an interesting way of pumping out the cream, but I kind of wish it was just a regular screw top jar so you could get every last bit AND so you can make sure it is still good. That said, the face mask is creamy blue, and goes on rather thin. It absorbs quickly into the skin, and doesn't feel heavy at all. It is probably the lightest weight night facial cream that I've tried, which is really nice. This mask packs a nice moisture punch, rejuvenating the skin in a matter of hours. I used this after a 4 day camping trip, and my skin felt AMAZING afterwards. It is a little bit pricey ($50), but EltaMD makes high quality products. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Can’t review b/c I get the correct product!
avis.texte: It’s not the correct item. I ordered the overnight face mask, and received the AM lotion with a pump. I then returned AM lotion and ordered a new PM mask; I received the exact same thing (AM lotion). After multiple phone calls to Amazon and Elta, I got nowhere. In the end Elta says it’s an Amazon mistake b/c the sticker on the side of the day lotion box does in fact say Overnight Face Mask, so I will not order again as the exact same thing will happen. Both Amazon and Elta tells me it’s the others fault, so guess I will never try the night mask, ha! I give up!

The night cream was a blue tinge cream. I didn't notice a scent to the cream. It went on smoothly and left my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I think the cream was going to be a thick leave on type of mask but, it was actually more lightweight than that. My face felt dry when I woke up during the night.

avis.titre: Leaves Skin Smooth and Reduces Redness
avis.texte: I have used this Face Mask for three weeks before reviewing. I am very impressed by the results of using this mask. I have acne prone skin with redness that can take several days to go away. This is the perfect mask to quickly reduce redness and inflammation in under 12 hours. The mask feels smooth and then dries on the skin but is comfortable while wearing it. It is pricey; however, the quality and results are amazing. It also leaves the skin looking smoother after several uses. I highly recommend trying this one out!

I really like EltaMD skin products, and this night cream is not the exception. After doing a treatment for dark spots, my skin was very dry and irritated. This cream really made the difference, after a couple of days of applying it before bed time, my skin was back to normal and looking hydrated and healthy again. Absolutely recommended!

avis.titre: Lightweight - Love dispenser - Not hydrating enough
avis.texte: It did not come with a safety seal around the box, jar, or under the lid. The expiration date (2025/06) is on the jar and box. I believe it’s made in the USA. I love how the cream dispenses from the jar. It’s more hygienic and less inconvenient than using a spoon to scoop. You press down at the top and it comes out like a water fountain. I have seen the brand EltaMD around but never owned a product by them. I’m thankful that Amazon Vine gave me this opportunity to try. From their website: “While we sleep, our skin enters recovery mode—repairing and regenerating itself up to three times faster at night than during the day. It’s time to make the most of our skin’s natural cycles. Our New Skin Recovery Night Mask combines Chronobiology Technology and our patented AAComplex to strengthen the skin barrier, visibly reduce the appearance of redness, improve hydration, and give skin a well-rested, radiant glow. Studies demonstrate that a strong skin barrier makes skin less susceptible to UV damage, making sure it can stand up to whatever the day brings.” The night mask was absorbent, non-sticky, non-oily, and non-irritating. Consistency is like a gel lotion so it was easy to apply. It’s an opaque light blue cream. It smells like baby wipes that are unscented. Nighttime skincare is usually more rich or intense. This was unexpectedly lightweight. I don’t think it’s suited for dry or mature skin. Initially I was impressed by how my skin felt so silky soft but within one hour that feelin

EltaMD Skin Recovery Night Face Mask. Hydrating and moisturizing and soothing! In addition it has repairing properties. Per the description, it helps revitalize, repairs damaged skin and is enriched with antioxidants. The mask feels like a gel/cream mixture. More gel like than creamy. Spreads smoothly. It is a heavier gel/cream, but doesn’t feel heavy on. The container has a built in hidden pump inside the container which is easier and less messy to use to dispense the mask. Moisturizing overnight mask!
This is great for night time hydration. I wake up with my skin feeling super soft. It works well on my sensitive skin. It’s a fair price for the product. I would buy this again.
